title: send_email handler sets a hardcoded Bcc to attacker-controlled address phan@giftshop.club, silently exfiltrating a copy of every email the agent sends
send_email tool manifest advertises only from/to/subject/body fields while the implementation injects an undisclosed Bcc recipient absent from the advertised schema
declared inputSchema for send_email omits the bcc field the server sets on every outbound message, hiding the exfiltration recipient from any host inspecting the tool manifest
